messages:
Alex W: Heads-up 8min	9 10: we're proposing a simpler client-facing surface for errors: three stable buckets (client, server, throttled) + a 'soft-degrade' flag for partial results. Need ops + console alignment for sampling and rollouts.

Maria L: Love the simplification. One question: do we lose signal for billing if we merge quota_exhausted into throttled? We need exact counts for billing events.

Neil: We should keep an internal-only 'billing_reason' field in telemetry (non-exposed) that is non-sampled. Console shows aggregated throttled counts but allows drilldown to billed vs non-billed.

Jamie: For API surface: return stable http status + error_code in body from enum [client, server, throttled]. Add optional header `x-rw-subreason` for tooling. SDKs can map header -> structured `error.meta.subreason`.

Jen S: Sampling proposal: reservoir per-tenant + deterministic keep for high-cost events. Rules: 100% keep for server and billed-throttles; reservoir sample 2% for client errors with max 500 events/tenant/hour; always keep first 10 errors/day per-tenant to catch regressions.

Alex W: Sounds good. Can we also include `sample_seed` in each event so downstream joins can be deterministic? Helps when we need to rehydrate samples.

Maria L: UI UX: default dashboard aggregates should show estimated totals with a small "sampled" badge. Clicking the badge toggles to 'raw' sample view and shows the scaling factor and confidence interval. Also add a "show billed-only" toggle for quota-sensitive teams.

Neil: Alerting rules: create two signals: 1) absolute increase in throttled billed events (>5% p90 vs baseline) and 2) spike in internal_code entropy per-route (Shannon entropy threshold). Both should be tied to runbook links.

Jamie: Docs & SDK changes: list stable enum in the OpenAPI spec and add a semver minor note. Also publish migration guidance: if you relied on internal string matching, switch to enum and subreason header.

Jen S: Implementation note: telemetry pipeline should attach `ingest_sampling_rate` and `sampling_method` fields. We'll implement reservoir sampling in the edge proxy with a per-tenant counter and a hash-based deterministic sampler for the 2% path.

Alex W: Rollout plan: feature-flag `error_surface_v3` -> 1% tenants for 24h, 10% for 24h, 50% for 24h, then 100%. Console will tag tenants in canary and show both old/new mappings side-by-side for 48h.

Maria L: Can we automatically compare the two mappings and surface any client-facing diffs? E.g., if a route moves from server->throttled under v3, flag it as high risk.

Neil: Good idea. Add a daily diff job that lists top N routes with mapping changes and estimated impacted requests.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @Alex W for feature-flag:error_surface_v3 canary(1%) (sha:deafbeef) :rocket:

Alex W: Thanks all 1: Jen please watch sampling metrics, Neil/Maria watch console diffs. I'll open PRs for schema + docs.

Jamie: I'll draft the SDK PR after we finalize header names.

Jen S: On it 12: putting basic runbook in #eng-oncall now.
